title: Read a number safely
summary: T-SQL: Read a number safely. Try the text 12.
introduction: TRY_CONVERT returns NULL when this text cannot be converted to int. COALESCE then supplies zero.
learningObjectives: Read a number safely with T-SQL

blocks.text: Connect to a practice SQL Server database with SSMS or sqlcmd. Run one example at a time. Results below show cell values or PRINT text without grid headers.
TRY_CONVERT cannot read cat as an int. Its NULL result is replaced by zero.

blocks.title: Watch out
blocks.text: A failed conversion is not automatically a real score of zero; choose a suitable fallback for your app.
